children: announced updated capital allocation priorities aimed at accelerating growth and driving long-term shareholder returns.

Key capital allocation priorities will include continuing to invest in Take 5 growth, leveraging its proven operating model, strong 4-wall economics, and compelling cash-on-cash returns. The growth is anticipated to come through units in new and existing markets and may include acquisitions where attractive. Driven Brands

set a long-term net leverage target of 2X to 3X net debt to adjusted EBITDA. The range was said to balance financial flexibility, investment capacity, and efficient use of capital while maintaining a strong balance sheet.
Returning capital to shareholders will also be a priority, beginning with a $100M share repurchase authorization.

"The strength of Driven Brand’s Growth and Cash framework has been on full display over the last several years as Driven reduced its net leverage from 5.0x at the end of 2023 to an expected 3.0x at the end of Q3 2026, reaching our 3.0x target a full quarter ahead of plan," highlighted CEO Danny Rivera. He noted the company is entering a new phase focused on deploying capital to support growth, maintaining financial flexibility, and enhancing shareholder value.

title: Driven Brands updates on capital allocation priorities
